programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Steve McQueen, James Garner, and Richard Attenborough headline a stellar cast in one of the most ingenious and suspenseful adventure films of all time as a team of Allied soldiers mount a daring escape from an inescapable Nazi POW camp.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: The Reivers
programme.desc: From the Pulitzer Prize-Winning novel by William Faulkner, Steve McQueen stars in the story of a Mississippi boy who drives to Memphis with two rascals in his family's new car—a 1905 Winton Flyer.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: The Reivers
programme.desc: From the Pulitzer Prize-Winning novel by William Faulkner, Steve McQueen stars in the story of a Mississippi boy who drives to Memphis with two rascals in his family's new car—a 1905 Winton Flyer.

programme.title: Thunder Road (1958)
programme.desc: Lucas Doolin (Robert Mitchum) runs moonshine across the mountain back roads, dodging the law and the lawless alike. With government agents closing in on him, it seems the county may run dry--but Doolin slams the pedal to the metal for one last run.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
programme.desc: John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassins' guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head, he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
programme.desc: John Wick (Keanu Reeves) uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: The Blackcoat's Daughter
programme.desc: Two terrified girls (Emma Roberts, Kiernan Shipka) must battle a mysterious evil force when they get left behind at their boarding school over winter break in this chilling and suspenseful horror film.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: Bones And All
programme.desc: In a world that cannot abide who they truly are, a young woman who is learning how to survive on the margins of society and an intense, disenfranchised drifter embark upon a road trip, searching for identity and chasing beauty in a perilous world.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Black Dynamite
programme.desc: An all-star cast led by Michael Jai White is featured in this 1970s-style blaxploitation action film about the legendary super crime fighter "Black Dynamite."

programme.title: Booty Call
programme.desc: Rushon and Nikki think they might be in love. There's just one problem. Nikki insists on double-dating with her best friend Lysterine on the night Rushon has reserved for romance. So Rushon brings his rude, crude, best boy Bunz to keep Lysty busy.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood’.

programme.title: Savage Dog
programme.desc: A story set in Indochina in 1959, a land beyond rule and a time without mercy, and the birth of a legend.

programme.title: Accident Man
programme.desc: Mike is a tough hitman, who makes his hits look like accidents or suicide. He's in a gang of hitmen, each with his own style. When his loved ex is killed, Mike looks for those responsible.

programme.title: Accident Man: Hitman's Holiday
programme.desc: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world.

programme.title: Can't Hardly Wait
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Huntington Hills High and that means one thing: Party! In one epic night, hearts will be broken, and new romances will blossom for six teens facing the rest of their lives - but not until the party ends!

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Not Another Teen Movie
programme.desc: Handsome John Hughes High jock Zack bets his friends that he can turn nerdy Janey into the most popular girl in class. With the help of Zack's sister, Catherine, Janey ditches her ponytail and glasses and turns beautiful. Zack falls in love with her.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball, but they struggle to keep their relationship alive as they pursue success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: The Iron Claw
programme.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers (Zac Efron, Jeremy Allen White, and Harris Dickinson), who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programme.title: Fighting With My Family
programme.desc: Former wrestler Ricky and his wife Julia make a living performing with their children Saraya and Zak. When brother and sister get the chance to audition for WWE, they learn that becoming a WWE Superstar demands more than they ever imagined possible.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Outer Threat
programme.desc: An astrophysicist's alien discovery forces him and his family to flee their home, chased by a mysterious pursuer. Their escape tests the limits between cosmic truth and paranoia

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: There's Something About Mary
programme.desc: A man reunites with his dream girl, even though their past was a disaster.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: A lonely divorcée visits a bewitching London department store to find a dress to transform her life. She finds a perfect, artery-red gown that unleashes a malevolent, unstoppable curse in this frightening, seductive, and darkly funny tale.

programme.title: Rings
programme.desc: When a college professor discovers the video rumored to kill viewers 7 days after watching, he and his students try to unlock the secrets of the Samara legend. But when the video goes viral, they must find a way to defeat Samara before it's too late.

programme.title: Tragedy Girls
programme.desc: A twist on the slasher genre, following two death-obsessed teenage girls who use their online show about real-life tragedies to send their small mid-western town into a frenzy, and cement their legacy as modern horror legends.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)
programme.desc: Kevin Kline won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in this wildly popular comedy about an intricate diamond heist that's peppered with the comical antics of Jamie Lee Curtis and John Cleese.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Come join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: Parker is a thief who lives by a personal code of ethics: Don't steal from people who can't afford it and don't hurt people who don't deserve it. But on his latest heist, his crew double-crosses him, steals his stash, and leaves him for dead.

programme.title: Good Time
programme.desc: A bank robber will stop at nothing to free his brother from prison, launching him into an odyssey through New York's dangerous criminal underworld.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Beans decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. STATE PROPERTY follows Beans and his crew, as they take over the city creating mayhem as their empire builds.

programme.title: The Relic
programme.desc: Come in—if you dare. The opening-night gala for a new exhibit at Chicago's natural history museum is underway. But be advised: something terrifying wants to make sure no one ever leaves.

programme.title: District 9
programme.desc: An extraterrestrial race forced to live in slum-like conditions on Earth suddenly finds a kindred spirit in a government agent who is exposed to their biotechnology.

programme.title: The Stuff
programme.desc: When a mysterious goo oozes from the earth, it's marketed as the newest dessert sensation. A private detective investigates the sweet treat that's absolutely delicious...and possibly lethal.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal

programme.title: The 400 Blows
programme.desc: A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram (Paul Newman) and Eddie (Sidney Poitier) are two expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris, where their music is celebrated. When they fall in love with two vacationing American girls, they must decide if they should move back to America with them.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: The king of rock 'n' roll, Elvis Presley, is as a lonely million-heir who gives up his fortune and trades identities with a water ski instructor to learn about life from the bottom up in this musical romp! Bill Bixby and Shelley Fabares also star.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) - and his wife, Elena (Zeta-Jones) - to take action.

programme.title: Hush
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: Urban Legend
programme.desc: When New England college student Natalie finds herself at the center of a series of sadistic murders seemingly inspired by urban legends, she resolves to find the truth about Pendleton's own legend. Rated: R

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Booty Call
programme.desc: Rushon and Nikki think they might be in love. There's just one problem. Nikki insists on double-dating with her best friend Lysterine on the night Rushon has reserved for romance. So Rushon brings his rude, crude, best boy Bunz to keep Lysty busy.

programme.title: Black Dynamite
programme.desc: An all-star cast led by Michael Jai White is featured in this 1970s-style blaxploitation action film about the legendary super crime fighter "Black Dynamite."

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood’.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Quinn, a member of a SWAT unit, steps out of a park fountain in an Asian city with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he pieces together clues from his past, he vaguely recalls his young daughter, who has been kidnapped.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Avengement
programme.desc: While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: Mr. Mom
programme.desc: Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high paying position at an advertising agency.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: Michael Douglas and Val Kilmer star in this terrific adventure set in 1896 East Africa. There, two lions on a man-eating rampage have shut down the construction of a railway. The beasts hunt together, showing no fear of man or fire.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Denzel Washington stars in this spell-binding thriller as the Chief of Police of a small town who finds himself caught in the eye of a storm as he investigates the murder of a woman he was secretly seeing….because all the evidence points to him!

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: The film chronicles the true story of Paul Rusesabinga (Don Cheadle), a brave hotel manager who risked his life and those of his family to take in more than 1,000 refugees during the 1994 genocide of the Tutsus by Hutu militia.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: True story about members of the Navajo tribe who proudly served the U.S. in WW II as code talkers by using their native language as a code to relay information to military leaders.

programme.title: Union Bound
programme.desc: Sargent Hoover went to war to preserve the Union. After being captured and sent to a prisoner of war camp, he understood what it was to be kept against his will. Together with a friend he escaped and aided by slaves made it to freedom.

programme.title: The Jade Pendant
programme.desc: The Old West becomes a battleground for power and revenge in this gripping epic based on true events. A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: The Outer Threat
programme.desc: An astrophysicist's alien discovery forces him and his family to flee their home, chased by a mysterious pursuer. Their escape tests the limits between cosmic truth and paranoia

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Pet Sematary

programme.title: Girls! Girls! Girls!
programme.desc: Elvis plays a charter-boat skipper who helps tourists land the big ones. Of course, plenty of beautiful girls want to land Elvis. But there’s something Elvis likes almost as much as romance–a boat!

programme.title: Blue Hawaii (1961)
programme.desc: His mother (Angela Lansbury) expects him to climb the corporate ladder. But Elvis would rather wear an aloha shirt than a white collar, so he goes to work as a tour guide. Lucky Elvis: his first customers are a car full of cuties.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: When sadistic thugs attack John Wick (Keanu Reeves) – a brilliantly lethal ex-assassin - he hunts them down with the skill and ruthlessness that made him an underworld legend.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
programme.desc: John Wick is forced out of retirement, and this time, he must face off against a shadowy international assassins' guild and more of the world's deadliest killers.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
programme.desc: John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassins' guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head, he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.

programme.title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: On a prom-night dare, a trio of high-school friends chant an incantation, unleashing an evil spirit from the past with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Silent Hill
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling horror action game, Silent Hill stars Radha Mitchell (Man on Fire) as Rose, a desperate mother who takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. Rating: R

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Black Dynamite
programme.desc: An all-star cast led by Michael Jai White is featured in this 1970s-style blaxploitation action film about the legendary super crime fighter "Black Dynamite."

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Superstar Eddie Murphy (The Nutty Professor) teams up with Owen Wilson (Zoolander, Behind Enemy Lines) for a hilarious, action-packed thrill ride. Famke Janssen (X-Men, GoldenEye) also stars as an ultra-sexy secret agent. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Lights Out
programme.desc: A drifting ex-soldier turns underground fighter with the help of a just-released ex-con, pitting them both against corrupt cops and hired killers gunning for them and all those they care about.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A
programme.desc: Dragon Ma a lieutenant in the 19th-century Hong Kong marines battles Pirates that have been terrorizing local waters in this must-see adrenaline-pumping adventure delivers all the intense thrills and witty fun that Jackie Chan fans demand!

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball, but they struggle to keep their relationship alive as they pursue success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman (Rainman) plays the likable graduate student and marathon runner of the title, unwillingly trapped in a killing game of intrigue involving a Nazi fugitive, Christian Szell.

programme.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
programme.desc: Michael Douglas and Val Kilmer star in this terrific adventure set in 1896 East Africa. There, two lions on a man-eating rampage have shut down the construction of a railway. The beasts hunt together, showing no fear of man or fire.

programme.title: Radio
programme.desc: For anyone who has ever had a dream and everyone with the courage to stand up for what they believe, comes the real-life story of Robert 'Radio' Kennedy. Experience Radio's journey from a man no one understands to the coach no one could live without.

programme.title: Labor Day
programme.desc: From Academy Award-nominated director Jason Reitman (Up in the Air, Juno), starring Kate Winslet and Josh Brolin as two strangers drawn together under incredible circumstances.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: American Outlaws
programme.desc: When a Midwest town learns that a corrupt railroad baron has captured the deeds to their homesteads without their knowledge, young ranchers join forces to take back what is rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
programme.desc: Cameron instantly falls for the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: When Beca joins the all-girl a capella singing group The Bellas, she pushes them to change up their repertoire as they climb their way to the top.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D
programme.desc: A young woman inherits an isolated mansion from a distant relative, but an unspeakable horror awaits her in the mansion's dank cellars.

programme.title: Alma & the Wolf
programme.desc: After a violent animal attack, paranoia spreads through Spiral Creek. But when Deputy Ren Accord gets too close, his son vanishes, and reality begins to fracture.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: We're No Angels (1989)
programme.desc: There's something funny about those two new priests. In fact, there's something downright hilarious. Because Robert De Niro and Sean Penn aren't clergymen at all.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Come join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: The Relic
programme.desc: Come in—if you dare. The opening-night gala for a new exhibit at Chicago's natural history museum is underway. But be advised: something terrifying wants to make sure no one ever leaves.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burn-out who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: Lifeguard
programme.desc: A fifteen-year high school reunion gets an aging lifeguard thinking about becoming a salesman in this romantic drama starring Sam Elliott, Anne Archer and Kathleen Quinlan.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Brian's Song
programme.desc: Based on the real-life relationship between teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers, the bond is established when Piccolo discovers that he is dying.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: The Astronaut's Wife
programme.desc: Astronaut Spencer Armacost and his beautiful schoolteacher wife are so passionately in love that they can sense each other even while he floats in space and she is 200,000 miles below. But in two minutes, it all turns to terror.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: The Last Castle
programme.desc: His service to his country made him a hero. One mistake made him a prisoner. For General Eugene Irwin (Redford), It's just a matter of serving out his sentance - until he makes the shocking discovery that his fellow inmates are being murdered.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: Guns Akimbo
programme.desc: Miles is a video game developer who inadvertently becomes the next participant in a real-life death match that streams online. While Miles soon excels at running away from everything, that won't help him outlast Nix, a killer at the top of her game.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: One look, and you know they're from a very strange place. They're from New Jersey, by way of France, by way of far-off, far-out Remulak. They're Coneheads.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: Comic icon Steve Martin steps into the shoes of the late Peter Sellers and wonderfully reprises the role of the bumbling, world famous Inspector Jacques Clouseau in this remake of Blake Edwards comedy classic, The Pink Panther.

programme.title: The Pink Panther 2
programme.desc: Inspector Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of international detectives just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: One look, and you know they're from a very strange place. They're from New Jersey, by way of France, by way of far-off, far-out Remulak. They're Coneheads.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
programme.desc: Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
programme.desc: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: 23rd century: the Federation Starship U.S.S. Enterprise™ is on routine training maneuvers, and Admiral James T. Kirk seems resigned to the fact that this inspection may well be the last space mission of his career. But Khan is back...

programme.title: The Outer Threat
programme.desc: An astrophysicist's alien discovery forces him and his family to flee their home, chased by a mysterious pursuer. Their escape tests the limits between cosmic truth and paranoia

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: A crash landing leaves Kitai Raige (Jaden Smith) and his legendary father Cypher (Will Smith) stranded on Earth, 1,000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity’s escape.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.

programme.title: The Ladies Man (2000)
programme.desc: Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money

programme.title: Nueva Zelanda más salvaje: Fortalezas Salvajes
programme.desc: En Nueva Zelanda, dos fortalezas salvajes protegen a los vulnerables animales nativos: una isla remota protegida por un foso de agua salada, la otra una ciudadela en la cima de una colina rodeada por una barrera a prueba de depredadores.

programme.title: Nueva Zelanda más salvaje: Legado oceánico
programme.desc: La primavera en la costa este de Nueva Zelanda es una época prometedora para el Lobo marino de Nueva Zelanda y el Albatros real del norte.

programme.title: Nueva Zelanda más salvaje: Los Bichos más espeluznantes
programme.desc: Las islas aisladas de Nueva Zelanda son famosas por ser un paraíso inusual, hogar de una variedad de vida salvaje única. Mejor conocido por sus aves no voladoras, reptiles antiguos y mamíferos costeros, una mirada más cercana revela otro mundo.

programme.title: Mega Movers
programme.desc: Las imponentes estatuas de 80 toneladas en la Isla de Pascua y las piedras del trilito de 800 toneladas del dios romano del Templo de los Truenos son ejemplo de antiguos milagros de ingeniería que parecerían ser demasiado pesados para ser trasladados.

programme.title: Mega Movers
programme.desc: Los Mega Movers arriesgan sus vidas y llegan a extremos para salvar cuatro aviones. Hay que arrastrar Un B-24 en una isla remota por altos acantilados y subirlo a un barco. Se recupera un P-61 "Black Widow" desde más de 2000 metros en una montaña.

programme.title: Mega Movers
programme.desc: ¿Y si hubiera que trasladar el Pentágono funcionando a pleno? Un Mega Mover expone su plan para este extraordinario traslado. Luego, esos mismos principios se ponen a prueba cuando hay que trasladar dos negocios prósperos con todo su contenido dentro.

programme.title: Mega Movers
programme.desc: El aeropuerto internacional de Denver es el más grande de los Estados Unidos por su tamaño. Imagínense intentar moverlo. En Nueva York, en el aeropuerto internacional JFK, parte de la famosa terminal de la TWA debe ser trasladada casi 400 metros.

programme.title: Mega Movers
programme.desc: El Queen Mary sería el mayor barco jamás trasladado por tierra. En Carolina del Sur, una réplica de 150 toneladas de una goleta de 1879 debe llevarse desde el dique seco, pasando por las calles de la ciudad, hasta el puerto.

programme.title: Naruto: La Voluntad De Fuego Sigue Ardiendo

programme.title: Naruto: Sensei Y Alumno: El Vínculo Del Shinobi
programme.desc: Después de que Tsunade le aconsejara dejar el camino del shinobi, Lee recuerda su primer encuentro con su maestro, Guy. Incapaz de dominar el ninjutsu y el genjutsu, Lee siempre ha sido despreciado por los otros.

programme.title: Naruto: Hay Que Verlo, Hay Que Conocerlo, ¿El Verdadero Rostro De Kakashi Sensei?
programme.desc: Naruto y sus dos compañeros siempre han querido ver el aspecto de Kakashi sin su máscara. Los tres hacen todo lo posible para ver su rostro completo.

programme.title: Naruto: Misión: Ayudar A Un Viejo Amigo En La Tierra Del Té
programme.desc: A Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se les asigna una misión de rango B en la Tierra del Té. Allí deben proteger a los participantes de una carrera durante el ritual ceremonial del Santuario Todoroki, que se celebra cada cuatro años.

programme.title: Naruto: La Carrera Comenzó, Problema En Altamar
programme.desc: Los sirvientes del jefe piensan que Idate ha hecho que su gran festival tradicional parezca una farsa. Jirocho cree que Idate ha huido y que está planeando algo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Corre, Idate, corre! ¡La isla Nagi espera!

programme.title: Naruto: La Gran Batalla Del Rayo Ondulado

programme.title: Naruto: El Ultimo Esfuerzo, Un Acto Final De Desesperación

programme.title: Naruto: La Batalla Comienza, Naruto Contra Sasuke

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Tierra de duendecillos

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba llega al santuario de Noé para rescatar a Mokuba, pero Mokuba quiere quedarse con Noé! ¿Mokuba ha visto el mal dentro de Kaiba, o se está haciendo algo más siniestro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Noé les da a los Cinco Grandes una última oportunidad para redimirse en un duelo de equipo de cinco contra dos donde Yugi y Joey se enfrentan a los Cinco Grandes!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Los Cinco Grandes concentran su ataque en Joey para que Yugi se vea obligado a pelear solo! ¡Superados y dominados, Yugi y Joey están cerca del final de la línea!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Los Cinco Grandes convocan a un dragón todopoderoso que previamente derrotó a Joey, Mai y Mokuba! Joey y Yugi sacan todas las paradas, pero ¿es eso suficiente para evitar que sus mentes se dispersen sobre la realidad virtual?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Es un duelo por el control de KaibaCorp cuando Noé se enfrenta a Kaiba! Pero, ¿puede Kaiba luchar con toda su fuerza después de enterarse de la verdad oculta sobre Noé ... y el pasado trágico que lo convirtió en lo que es hoy?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El Arca de Shinato de Noé roba monstruos en su fortaleza para usar como un muro impenetrable de sirvientes! ¿Cómo puede Kaiba lastimar a Noé cuando Noé tiene un flujo interminable de monstruos para protegerse?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Kaiba está por terminar con Noé, pero Mokuba protege a Noé de su golpe final! ¿Kaiba sacrificará a su amado hermano a cambio de libertad, o el vínculo fraternal seguirá siendo irrompible?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean conoce a una anciana aristocrática cuando casi atropella a su perro. Está encantado de ser invitado a almorzar en su mansión grandiosa. Lo que no se da cuenta de que la dama y su siniestro mayordomo no son lo que parecen ...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que Mikami había escrito el nombre de todos los investigadores en el Death Note, ya había pasado un minuto y todos seguían vivos. Near obtiene el Death Note y todo es revelado.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: El brillante pero aburrido estudiante Light Yagami de repente se encuentra sosteniendo el poder de la vida y la muerte en sus manos, el Death Note. Cuando asesinatos empiezan a acumular, el detective L toma el caso y ¡una batalla de inteligencia comienza!

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Mientras los criminales del mundo continúan muriendo, L se reúne con representantes de varias naciones. Él solicita que un nuevo cuartel general de la fuerza especial sea creado en Japón bajo la dirección de no otro que Soichiro Yagami ¡El padre de Light!

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light, conocido mundialmente como Kira, prueba el alcance de los poderes del Death Note matando a 6 convictos de diferentes maneras, así confirma que puede controlar las acciones de sus víctimas ¡antes de que mueran!

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: El Asalto

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Theresa lleva a casa a Simon para anunciar su boda en la fiesta de aniversario de su padre.

programme.title: Un amigo como tú
programme.desc: Cuando Steve Dallas (Owen Wilson), un meteorólogo mujeriego, se entera de que su mejor amigo Ben Baker (Zach Galifianakis) perdió a su distanciado padre, ambos vuelven a la casa de la infancia de Ben y descubren que Ben heredó la fortuna de la familia.

programme.title: Una Loca Película de Vampiros
programme.desc: Es una comedia sobre la ansiedad adolescente contemporánea y películas románticas. Becca una adolescente ansiosa, no vampiro, está confundida sobre dos chicos.

programme.title: Asilo Embrujado
programme.desc: Cuando un grupo de exploradores urbanos tiene la oportunidad de explorar uno de los manicomios más embrujados del mundo, encuentra algo verdaderamente maligno que no los dejará salir y los llevará al límite de la cordura.

programme.title: Criaturas Nocturnas
programme.desc: Dylan Dog, un antiguo agente de Scotland Yard, trabaja como detective privado especializado en la investigación de fenómenos paranormales.

programme.title: It Comes at Night
programme.desc: Una joven que intenta restaurar un molino abandonado en una zona remota pronto descubre que el lugar alberga una criatura peligrosa.

programme.title: Más Allá del Tiempo
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes enamorados en los años 70, con un hijo pequeño, se separan debido a un accidente en un viaje en barco. Treinta y cinco años después, se reencuentran.

programme.title: EVA + CANDELA
programme.desc: La ambición profesional de dos mujeres fuertes e independientes las une, pero también es lo que finalmente las separa, ya que somos testigos de su intensa metamorfosis amorosa en medio de etapas

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Película independiente situada en la peligrosa frontera entre México y Estados Unidos. Tras cruzar la frontera de manera ilegal, Miguel, es acusado injustamente de asesinar a la esposa de un sheriff de Arizona.

programme.title: Jobs
programme.desc: En 1976, Steve Jobs, que había dejado de estudiar, pone en marcha un nuevo proyecto junto a su colega Steve Wozniak. Desde el garaje de los padres de Jobs, ambos revolucionarán el mundo con la invención de la computadora Apple.

programme.title: Fanáticos

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un tranquilo vagabundo es engañado para que acepte un trabajo de conserje en el ahora condenado Willy's Wonderland.

programme.title: Paladin II: La Corona y el Dragon
programme.desc: Una joven noble debe cumplir con su llamado para convertirse en la nueva paladina, la legendaria mata-dragones.

programme.title: El Medallón Perdido

programme.title: La llamada de Shanghái

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Ashley, una mujer muy afortunada, cambia su suerte con el desdichado Jake.

programme.title: El encanto de la bestia

programme.title: La Frontera

programme.title: Conspiración Mortal
programme.desc: Un suceso violento desencadena una serie de eventos trágicos vistos desde diferentes perspectivas en una ciudad de los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Diamantes Negros

programme.title: Aire Libre

programme.title: Charro A La Fuerza

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean considera que la limpieza puede ser un negocio sucio. Llegó la primavera y Mr. Bean comienza la limpieza. Pero no hay agua caliente. Una improvisada tubería demuestra que Bean sabe más de plomería de lo que pensaba.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean se olvida del cumpleaños de su fiel amigo Teddy. La única que se acordó es la novia de Bean, Irma Gobb. Ahora Mr Bean debe decidir cual será el regalo perfecto para Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: El juego de croquet de Mr Wicket es interrumpido por un topo ofensivo. Ella le ordena a Bean sacarlo del jardín.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel deciden saltarse un día de escuela y trabajo. Se hacen pasar por enfermos, pero pronto se encuentran en grandes problemas, cuando son atrapados en un robo de banco y terminan apareciendo en las noticias.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan le apuesta a Kel que no puede estar una semana sin beber gaseosa de naranja, por lo que Kenan hará cualquier artimaña para que Kel pierda.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Cuando el jugador estrella de baloncesto, Harper Ron,se lesiona la rodilla al resbalarse en un charco de gaseosa de naranja en Rigby’s, Kenan y Kel son culpados y se convierten en las personas más odiadas de la ciudad de Chicago.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Rigby's ha sido elegida como el set de la nueva película "Policía de Supermercado 3", y Kenan y Kel se ofrecen como extras. Todo lo que tienen que hacer es seguir las instrucciones del director, pero terminan arruinando todo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Después de que Kel le causara serias heridas en la espalda a Roger, este le prohibió la entrada a la casa de los Rockmore. Como resultado de ello, Kel trata de convencer a Roger que le permita volver a entrar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡La batalla de Joey y Kaiba alcanza su clímax rugiente! ¿Joey eliminará su mayor dolor de cabeza y realmente le enseñará a Kaiba una o dos cosas sobre ser un verdadero duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es el enfrentamiento crítico de Battle City con el destino del mundo en juego: ¡Yami Yugi contra Marik! Si Yami Yugi pierde, ¡Yugi se tomará unas vacaciones permanentes en el Reino de las Sombras!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Marik demuestra que su Dragón Alado de Ra es la carta de Dios egipcio más fuerte al destruir a Slifer, el Dragón del Cielo! Ninguna de las cartas de Yugi puede resistir su asalto, pero un regalo de Kaiba puede cambiar el duelo…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi no puede golpear los puntos de vida de Marik, y con cada turno que pasa, Marik está un paso más cerca de derrotar a Yugi con un golpe final del Dragón Alado de Ra…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con Yugi al final de sus cuerdas y el maniático Marik librando una guerra total, ¿puede el amigo más viejo de Marik llegar a Marik a tiempo para ayudarlo a recuperar sus sentidos antes de que su locura lo abrume?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¿La fuerza combinada de todos los monstruos de Yugi será suficiente para derrotar a un dios egipcio que acabó con otros dos poderosos dioses egipcios? ¡El destino del mundo está en juego con el final del Torneo Battle City!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Las tres cartas de Dios egipcio son robadas! ¡Un nuevo villano aterrador emerge! ¡Monstruos reales comienzan a aparecer en todo el mundo! ¿Podrán Yugi y la pandilla descubrir cómo se conectan estos extraños eventos antes de que el planeta sea destruido?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Rumbo a las nubes! ¡Capturen el South Bird!

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡¿Los sueños no se vuelven realidad?! Bellamy contra la Alianza Saruyama

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: Guerra de rebeldes 2 La Cacería
programme.desc: La coalición internacional lucha por recuperar a Daniel mientras que los máscaras negras se apoderan por la fuerza de más adeptos para su grupo y elaboran grandes cantidades de gas sarín para culminar con su lucha.

programme.title: La Hora de la Verdad
programme.desc: El plan de los tres ladrones lo tiene todo para salir adelante -secuestrar al nieto de un millonario y ganar dinero fácil- pero no contaban con el carisma del bebé, lo que enternece el corazón del trío y dificulta la tarea.

programme.title: Una Loca Película de Vampiros
programme.desc: Es una comedia sobre la ansiedad adolescente contemporánea y películas románticas. Becca una adolescente ansiosa, no vampiro, está confundida sobre dos chicos.

programme.title: No es otra pelÍcula de Amor
programme.desc: Nueva comedia de los creadores de "Scary Movie", que en esta ocasión parodian todo tipo de comedias románticas.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: Parodia de "300" y otras películas. El rey Leónidas y su ejército de 12 hombres luchan contra Jerjes de Persia para defender la libertad de Esparta.

programme.title: It Comes at Night
programme.desc: Una joven que intenta restaurar un molino abandonado en una zona remota pronto descubre que el lugar alberga una criatura peligrosa.

programme.title: Don’t Look Away
programme.desc: No se mueve, no piensa, simplemente mata. Para una mujer joven, un encuentro casual con esta entidad sobrenatural resulta devastador. Frankie aprende que una vez que vea el maniquí es posible que no haya un final a la vista excepto el suyo propio.

programme.title: Oculus
programme.desc: Una mujer intenta exonerar a su hermano, condenado por asesinato, demostrando que el crimen fue cometido por un fenómeno sobrenatural.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Película independiente situada en la peligrosa frontera entre México y Estados Unidos. Tras cruzar la frontera de manera ilegal, Miguel, es acusado injustamente de asesinar a la esposa de un sheriff de Arizona.

programme.title: Anton - Lazos de Amistad
programme.desc: La revolución y la venganza, el miedo y la esperanza, el amor y el odio convergen en un pequeño pueblo ucraniano en 1919. Esta película explora un período poco conocido en la historia rusa, moldeado por la división política, étnica y religiosa.

programme.title: Un Saco de Canicas
programme.desc: Dos niños hermanos judíos huyen a través de Francia durante la ocupación alemana, en plena Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Fanáticos
programme.desc: Un grupo de fanáticos de Star Wars viaja a Skywalker Ranch para robar una copia de "The Phantom Menace", para que su amigo enfermo terminal pueda verla antes de su lanzamiento en los cines varios meses después.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Un tranquilo vagabundo es engañado para que acepte un trabajo de conserje en el ahora condenado Willy's Wonderland.

programme.title: Runner, Runner
programme.desc: Richie cree que lo estafaron, va a Costa Rica para enfrentar a un magnate.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.

programme.title: El Niño de Oro
programme.desc: Mats es un chico corriente como cualquier otro. Pero cuando encuentras pantalones que contienen una cantidad ilimitada de dinero, ¡todo cambia! De repente, el mundo está a sus pies y puede cumplir todos sus sueños.

programme.title: Slime Una Aventura Pegajosa
programme.desc: Indy y Olivia están locas por hacer baba, pero tienen problemas cuando el jefe de una gran fábrica de juguetes inicia una campaña contra la baba para aumentar sus propias ventas de juguetes.

programme.title: Sopa de Tortilla
programme.desc: Un master chef mexicanoamericano y padre de tres hijas ha perdido su gusto por la comida, pero no por la vida.

programme.title: Breaking Through: En el ritmo del corazón
programme.desc: Casey es una joven bailarina que es descubierta en YouTube por un ojeador. Cuando Casey coge popularidad en el mundo de internet, deberá encontrar el equilibrio entre su verdadera identidad y su identidad online.

programme.title: El encanto de la bestia
programme.desc: Una versión moderna de la historia de "La Bella y la Bestia", donde un adolescente de Nueva York se transforma en un monstruo espantoso para encontrar el amor verdadero.

programme.title: Just friends

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Irma Gobb tendrá una cena romántica junto a Mr. Bean, pero el no está del todo preparado. Al quedarse dormido en el baño mientras el pollo se cocina en el horno, Mr Bean debe ingeniárselas para tener lista la cena. Un invitado sorpresa tiene la solución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Una pelota de tenis se atranca en una tubería de drenaje en la azotea. ¿De cuántas maneras diferentes puede Bean intentar recuperarla? Su único problema es el miedo a las alturas.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean muerde un pedazo de palomitas de maíz, lo que le causa mucho dolor. Él piensa que al sacar su diente doloroso, resolverá sus problemas. Quitársela el mismo parece no dar solución y por eso deberá ir al dentista

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de un infortunado accidente, Mr Bean debe reemplazar al gato tuerto de su vecina. Sin embargo en sus reiterados intentos por limpiar el salón, Bean no encuentra manera de controlar al gato.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Ir a la tienda por provisiones se convierte en una pesadilla cuando una interminable lista de compras y un carrito aplastado con una rueda torcida conspiran para arruinar su día. Por lo que Mr. Bean decide construir un súper carrito de supermercado.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean lleva a su casa una urraca herida y pronto se da cuenta de que le gusta coleccionar cosas brillantes que toma de las casas vecinas. Pero adivinen quién tiene la culpa...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr.Bean imagina que está surfeando en Hawái, pero es interrumpido por su vecina. Por eso decide surfear por las escaleras en una tabla de planchar, lo que tiene consecuencias peligrosas. Con la Sra. Wicket en el hospital, Bean deberá cuidar de su gato

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pierde su barco embotellado, que queda atrapado en el camión del lechero. Lo busca de manera frenética, solo para verlo desaparecer en la lechería local, entre otras botellas. Una misión imposible.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Con Teddy en la tintorería, Mr Bean se siente solo. Por fortuna, aparece un pez dorado en el estanque del jardín. Bean se divierte mucho con su nuevo amigo hasta que, en la playa, descubre que algunos peces son gigantescos y tienen grandes dientes.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Un mecánico estafa a Mr Bean. Le hace creer que su auto no tiene reparación y que tiene que llevarse a la trituradora. Mr Bean decide construir un globo aerostático y desde el aire descubre al mecánico paseando con su auto.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Durante una visita a la Galería Nacional de Londres, Mr Bean es testigo del robo de una importante obra de arte. Sabueso que es, persigue al culpable a través del Canal hacia París. Le esperan muchos obstáculos.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean va al cine a ver algunas películas de terror, pero las cosas se vuelven locas cuando se asusta hasta el hueso. Su imaginación le juega una mala pasada. Todo una pesadilla.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean e Irma Gobb salen en una cita. Todo marcha muy bien; una película romántica y una cena a la luz de las velas. Pero no todo es perfecto. Bean olvida su billetera y la obliga a pagar todo.

programme.desc: Luffy y sus compañeros han llegado al cielo. Pero en cuanto llegaron, fueron atacados por un extraño ser y salvados por otro ser igual de extraño, el caballero del Cielo, el cual les da un silbato para que le pidan ayuda para posteriores ocasiones.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡El país de Dios, Skypiea! Ángeles en una playa de nubes
programme.desc: Finalmente, los Sombrero de Paja llegan a "tierra firme". Allí conocen a Conis y Pagaya, los primeros habitantes que les brindarán su ayuda y les informarán un poco sobre cómo funciona este mundo y les dicen qué son los dials.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡La tierra prohibida! ¡La isla en la que vive Dios y el Juicio del Cielo!
programme.desc: Nami se marcha por su cuenta con el waver que le prestó Pagaya, el problema es que llega a una misteriosa isla repleta de gente con aspecto peligroso y presencia en primera persona un misterioso ataque realizado por "Dios".

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡¿Ya somos criminales?! Los defensores de la ley de Skypiea
programme.desc: Mientras los Sombrero de Paja están en Playa Ángel, aparecen los Boinas Blancas, quienes acusan a nuestros protagonistas de haber quebrantado la ley en numerosas ocasiones y les imponen una enorme multa.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡¿Es posible escapar?! ¡La Prueba de Dios se pone en marcha!
programme.desc: Como ahora son considerados criminales, algunos de los Sombrero de Paja están dispuestos a abandonar la isla del cielo para volver a "su mundo". Para ello contarán con la ayuda de Conis, quien les explicará una forma de salir de allí.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Una trampa en la calle Lovely! El todopoderoso Enel
programme.desc: Tras la desaparición del Going Merry con algunos de sus tripulantes, Luffy, Sanji y Zoro deciden salir en su busca. Nuevamente, Conis los guiará a través de la calle Lovely para encontrarlos, pero al final cambia de idea y recibe un ataque del dios Enel.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Avanza, Cuervo! Hacia el altar de sacrificios
programme.desc: Luffy y compañía siguen con su camino para reunirse con la tripulación que estaba en el Going Merry, pero no paran de encontrarse con pruebas y obstáculos en el camino para evitar que lleguen hasta el altar de sacrificios.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡10 % de probabilidad de supervivencia! ¡Satori, el sacerdote usuario del mantra!
programme.desc: Por decisión de Luffy, los chicos atraviesan la puerta de la Esfera para someterse a la prueba. Allí se encuentran con Satori, un extraño sacerdote con un poder igual de extraño y terrible que les causará muchos problemas.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡La amenaza de la Prueba de las Esferas! Batalla a muerte en el Bosque de las Ilusiones
